summary: Download a PDF that documents how your PIM Manager is set up, and close public access fully when you go private.

new.title: As-built document as a PDF
new.text: Settings > Copy & tools > As-built document downloads a PDF of how this installation is configured. It is made inside your environment and never contains secrets or people.
new.action: On an existing environment, an Owner of the resource group runs the hosting access setup script once after the next update; the update log says so.

new.title: Support can request the as-built document
new.text: When you grant Invardia support the new as-built access level, support can create the same PDF on request. It is deleted after 24 hours.

new.title: Going private closes public access too
new.text: Converting an environment to private now also turns off public access to the container registry, and optionally the database, once the private path is proven complete.

new.title: Progress during the long hosting step
new.text: A tracked multi-tenant install now shows each part of the hosting step as it happens, instead of minutes of silence.

fixes.title: No false Azure SQL warning on new subscriptions
fixes.text: On a new subscription, the region check now explains that Azure SQL is checked after setup registers it, instead of showing a confusing warning.
